tagline: A world leader in finding, mining and processing the Earth's mineral resources
hero_kpi_rationale: Iron ore production volume: master KPI in the diversified mining sector. Rio Tinto is one of the two largest global producers (with BHP), making it the primary driver of volume and cash flow. No distinct wow factor identified outside the core business.

kpis.name: Iron Ore Volume
kpis.explanation: Quantity of iron ore extracted annually by Rio Tinto.
kpis.description: Iron ore production volume is a key indicator of operational performance. Rio Tinto maintains a high pace across its Australian assets.
kpis.signal: Record production in 2025, supported by operational efficiency in Pilbara.

kpis.name: Copper Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from copper sales, a strategic metal for the energy transition.
kpis.description: Copper is becoming increasingly central to Rio Tinto's strategy, with expanding projects such as Oyu Tolgoi.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by copper demand for power grids and electric vehicles.

kpis.name: Realized Price per Tonne
kpis.explanation: Average price received by Rio Tinto for one tonne of iron ore sold.
kpis.description: The realized price reflects the premium quality of Pilbara iron ore and customer contract management.
kpis.signal: Price above spot due to product quality and long-term contracts.

kpis.name: Underlying EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit margin before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: The underlying EBITDA margin remains high due to cost control and asset quality.
kpis.signal: Margin among the highest in the sector, indicating operational excellence.

kpis.name: Cost per Tonne (Pilbara)
kpis.explanation: Cash cost to produce one tonne of iron ore in Pilbara.
kpis.description: Rio Tinto maintains a leading global position in terms of production costs.
kpis.signal: Among the lowest costs worldwide, a major competitive advantage.

kpis.name: Reserves Life
kpis.explanation: Number of years proven reserves can support current production levels.
kpis.description: Rio Tinto's iron ore reserves are among the largest and most durable in the world.
kpis.signal: Long-term visibility secured for iron ore.

kpis.name: Capex (mining and projects)
kpis.explanation: Annual investments in mines and new projects.
kpis.description: Capex supports the expansion of Oyu Tolgoi and energy transition initiatives.
kpis.signal: Capex increasing to support copper and decarbonization projects.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after deduction of sustaining capex.
kpis.description: FCF is rising due to strong operational performance and sustained prices.
kpis.signal: Strong FCF in 2025, enabling high dividends and share buybacks.

kpis.name: Low-Carbon Product Premium
kpis.explanation: Revenue from low-carbon footprint products sold at a premium price.
kpis.description: Low-carbon revenue is growing due to demand from customers like Apple for zero-carbon aluminum.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in premium linked to ELYSIS and recycled products.

kpis.name: Major Greenfield Project
kpis.explanation: Investment in a new large-scale mining project (greenfield), such as Oyu Tolgoi or Simandou.
kpis.description: The Oyu Tolgoi project (Mongolia) is in final development phase, with first production expected in 2026.
kpis.signal: Accelerated capex on Oyu Tolgoi, key for future copper production.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the text.
